join.title: Join the Collective
join.lede: Be part of a body of creative work exploring the systems shaping our lives. Submit posters in our open calls, contribute to the archive, discover new voices, and take part in upcoming grants, residencies, exhibitions, and conversations.

signIn.title: Sign In
signIn.lede: Enter the email you joined with and we’ll send you a code to sign in.

codeLede: to {email} to sign in. It expires in 15 minutes.

photo.label: Photo (Optional)
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Seen by the UNBLOCKED team with your entries.
